scope: Proposition 5.1 of the manuscript “A counterexample to Tachikawa's second conjecture” (preprints/A-counterexample-to-Tachikawas-second-conjecture-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 199 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 332c2535f60d4ad6), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 17. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Put J = T ⊗C R, where R is the resolution in (4.10). There is a triangle in the derived category of T-modules s[2] −→ J −→ s τ − → s[3], (5.1) and the connecting class generates the Yoneda algebra: Ext∗ T (s, s) = k[τ], |τ| = 3. (5.2) The complex J is bounded below, has finite projective T-terms, and has bounded homology.
